summary: App boots cleanly via uvicorn, root returns 200, /feedback without auth returns 401 (auth enforced). No /health endpoint exists (404), consistent with planner intent that FORBIDS /health. Server was started and cleanly stopped; port 8765 freed.

environment.server: uvicorn (ASGI), serves FastAPI app directly - no build step

pre_deploy.description: Confirm app imports cleanly and count routes
pre_deploy.health_endpoint_note: No /health route - confirms planner intent that FORBIDS a /health endpoint

deploy.description: Start uvicorn locally in background on free port 8765
boot_log: INFO:     Uvicorn running on http://127.0.0.1:8765 (Press CTRL+C to quit)

post_deploy_healthcheck.description: Health-check baseline root (planner intent forbids /health) and verify auth enforcement on /feedback

teardown.description: Stop uvicorn process and verify port freed
teardown.port_after_stop: PORT 8765 FREE - server stopped (no listening connections, no orphan python uvicorn processes)
teardown.background_task_note: Background uvicorn task reported exit code 127 - this is the expected result of Stop-Process forcibly terminating the foreground-blocking server, NOT a boot failure. Boot log and all HTTP responses confirm the server ran correctly before teardown.

stack_gap.detail: The CoolHan devops-deployer agent definition and harness assume a Node toolchain: it calls 'npm run build', 'npm run lock:status', 'npm run spec:validate', 'npm run deploy', 'npm run healthcheck', etc. The actual target app is a Python FastAPI project with NO build step - uvicorn serves the ASGI app directly from source (python -m uvicorn src.main:app). There is no package.json, no npm scripts, no compiled artifact. The entire npm-based lock/validate/deploy/healthcheck pipeline in devops-deployer.md is inapplicable to this stack and was substituted with equivalent Python/uvicorn + curl commands.
stack_gap.recommendation: Harness should detect project type (presence of package.json vs requirements.txt/pyproject.toml) and select the appropriate deploy + healthcheck commands. For Python: pre-deploy = import check, deploy = uvicorn/gunicorn, healthcheck = HTTP probe.
